name: The Windows Satan Game
summary: This game is played with the mouse. You must defend various windows components from attack by worms, pacman and Anton la vey. In the original version of the game, when a component got destroyed the game would delete components from windows itself, for example if clippit got hit the game would uninstall the office assistant. That version was never released and only used on school computers as a prank. The version provided here is safe to play.
